summary: Iteration 12: Full end-to-end testing of the new Home Feed feature. All 22 backend pytest tests passed (100%). All frontend admin and customer UI flows verified with Playwright. The feature is fully functional: admin can create/edit/delete/publish home posts, customer home page correctly shows only published posts in their respective sections, and draft posts are properly filtered out.

design_issues.screen: Admin Home Feed - New Post Dialog
issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} — minor a11y issue, add a <DialogDescription> to the Dialog in HomeFeedTab.jsx to suppress warning

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add <DialogDescription> to the HomeFeedTab.jsx Dialog to resolve accessibility warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'
critical_code_review_comments: home_posts.py PUT endpoint: `updates = {k: v for k, v in data.dict().items() if v is not None}` — This correctly handles is_published=False (False != None), but it means you cannot unset version_tag to null via PUT once set. This is acceptable for current use case.
HomeFeedTab.jsx is clean and well-structured. All data-testids are present. The token is correctly passed from AdminDashboard.
HomePage.jsx catches VOD fetch errors gracefully with .catch(() => ({ data: [] })) — good defensive coding.
No _id MongoDB ObjectId leak detected — home_posts route correctly uses {_id: 0} in projections and doc.pop('_id', None) after insert.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 2 test posts during testing (v1.0 Released, Dark Mode Coming Soon). DB is clean after tests.
